Sandbox_LiveWireExtended_BuildingBand_to: Width in squares of the strip around a connected building that also gets power (porch, garden path). The game powers whole 8 x 8 blocks, so the powered area is rounded up to them.
Sandbox_LiveWireExtended_HouseBoardPerce: Share of the map's buildings that already have a breaker board (their own electrical box when they have one). Linked to an inverter, it is prewired room by room, without labels: find out which breaker feeds what. Unwired appliances of the building then have no current.
